title: Aranya value uncertainty and provenance
description: Binds an agricultural value to its uncertainty and its evidential basis. This is the mechanism that prevents a modelled soil estimate from ever being presented as a laboratory measurement.

kind.description: How the value came into existence. 'measured' and 'lab_reported' are the only kinds that may be described as a measurement.

basis.description: The evidential basis. Must be consistent with kind; validated by the normalizer.

spatial_resolution_m.description: Nominal ground sample distance or grid cell size in metres. Null when the provider does not state it. This is what makes the resolution limit visible to the UI.

method_uncertainty.description: Spread reported by the provider for this specific value, not a generic figure.

suitable_for.description: Decision scales this value may legitimately inform. The UI and rule engine MUST consult this list before making a recommendation.

prohibited_claims.description: Explicit phrasings that must never be rendered for this value, given its kind and basis. Enforced as a rendering constraint, not a guideline.

confidence_label.description: Plain-language confidence for display. Must be derived from measured evidence, never asserted by a provider's marketing copy.

evidence_refs.description: Stable ids or citations backing this value, resolvable in data/crop_knowledge or the cited source's documentation.
